name: 돌발성 탐지
description: 분석합니다 the 돌발성 패턴 텍스트에서 to distinguish AI 생성 from 인간이 작성한 content.
useCase: Detecting AI text through 분석 of 문장 길이 and complexity variation
mechanism: 측정합니다 the variation (돌발성) in sentence structures, lengths, and complexity throughout a text. Human writing naturally varies 사이의 simple and complex sentences, short and long paragraphs. AI 생성 text tends to maintain a more uniform level of complexity, resulting in lower 돌발성 scores.
source: Guo et al. (2023) - How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection, arXiv
algorithm: Sentence Length Variance + Structural Complexity Scoring + Moving Window Analysis
parameters: 윈도우 크기: 5 sentences, Metrics: length 분산, complexity index, transition 엔트로피
strengths:
• 간단하고 해석 가능한 지표
• 어느 정도 언어에 독립적
• 다른 텍스트 방법과 결합 시 잘 작동
• 모든 길이의 텍스트에서 빠른 계산
limitations:
• Lower 정확도 as standalone detector
• Academic and technical writing naturally has low 돌발성
• AI models are improving at mimicking human variability
• Very short texts are unreliable

references.title: Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? arXiv.
Mitchell, E. et al. (2023). DetectGPT: Zero-Shot Machine-Generated Text Detection using Probability Curvature. ICML.
Tulchinskii, E. et al. (2024). Intrinsic Dimension Estimation for Robust Detection of AI-Generated Texts. NeurIPS.
